summary.headline: Thunder-Divination Omens
summary.text: Thunder-divination by an unknown author, preserved on folios 327v–329 of a Bologna codex, combines zodiacal and monthly omens. It compares the fragment with Egyptian divination, Nigidius, Vicellus, Melampus, and Lydus, then gives thunder omens for Aries, Taurus, and Gemini and for March, April, and May, including predictions of plague, crop destruction, war, and political upheaval.
